sentences.text: Renu vs Narendra Kumar on 27 November, 2025

In The Supreme Court Of India
 Civil Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition(Civil) No.1636 Of 2025
 Renu Petitioner(S)
 Versus
 Narendra Kumar Respondent(S)
 O R D E R
1.

Our order dated 14.11.2025 reads thus:-
1. It appears that the parties have been able to arrive at an amicable settlement before the Supreme Court Mediation Centre.
2. The Settlement Agreement dated 27-10-2025 has been reduced into writing duly signed by the parties, their respective counsel including the Mediator.
3.
In accordance with the terms of settlement, the wife has gone back to her matrimonial home.
There is one child also born in the wed-lock.
4. The parties are present before us.
5. Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the wife brought to our notice that once again problems have cropped up.

While she is trying to save the marriage and discharge all her matrimonial obligations, the father-in-law called the Police one fine day alleging misbehaviour and ill-treatment towards him at the end of the daughter-in-law.
6. We were told that Police was called for who in turn took the wife to the Police Station.

The wife 14:30:00 IST Reason:
is quite disturbed after all such developments.
7. We spoke to the husband and made ourselves very clear that if there is any complaint in future,
we would put an end to this marriage and he would have to pay maintenance per month to his wife and also to his minor son.

1
8. Prima facie, it appears that the husband has no say in the family.
The parents perhaps are creating trouble in the matrimonial life of their son.
9. In such circumstances, referred to above, we would like to speak to the father-in-law of the petitioner before us.

10. We are informed that they are residing in Meerut, U.P.
11.
They shall join online on 24-11-2025.
Today both the husband and the father-in-law are personally present in the Court.
They both have tendered oral apology before us.
They have assured us that they would not ill-treat the petitioner in any manner.
3. We have also impressed upon the petitioner that she must live her marital life peacefully without getting into any other controversies.
4. The Settlement Agreement dated 27-10-2025 has already been reduced into writing duly signed by the parties, their respective counsel including the Mediator.

5. The Settlement Agreement reads thus:-

Block C, Kamal Vihar, Kamalpur, Burari, New Delhi  110084, here in after referred to as First Party.
AND Mr. Narendra Kumar R/o 49/2 Gali No. 1, Subhash Nagar Police Station, Civil Line District, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, here in after referred to as Second Party.

sentences.text: AND WHEREAS during the hearing of the above cited Transfer Petition, the Parties were referred to Mediation by the Honble Supreme Court vide its Order dated 03.09.2025.

Thereafter, mediation proceedings through physical hearing were held on 23.09.2025 and today i.e. 27.10.2025 after discussions and reconcilliation held between the Parties and their family members (father of the Second Party) held during the mediation proceedings, the Parties have arrived at an amicable settlement and opt for mutual consent and have agreed to settle their matrimonial disputes to live together as Husband and Wife on the following terms:
1. That the Parties agree that it shall be possible for them to stay together as Husband and Wife and to pursue their matrimonial life, and the First Party has agreed to maintain the matrimonial relationship and stay at her matrimonial home, and to reconcile irrespective of all their previous differences.
2. That in consideration of the above, the First Party will not claim any further amount towards past, present and future maintenance, alimony, arrears or expenditure from the Second Party.

3. It is settled that after compliance of the term of the present settlement agreement,
there shall remain no dispute due between the Parties arising of the said marriage Renu vs Narendra Kumar on 27 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189475631/
3 and that none of the Parties shall file any civil or criminal proceedings against each other in future and that if any other case/petition/application/complaint etc.
between the Parties is pending before any Court or Authority between the parties, the same shall be withdrawn or got disposed of by the respective party.
4.

sentences.text: It is settled that the son of the Parties shall complete his current semester of VIIth Standard at his present school till April 2026 and it is also agreed that in the meantime, the Parties can visit each other along with their son.

5. That the Second Party has agreed to maintain (including food, clothing and shelter) the First Party and their son, and provide a dignified life/look after/take care of the First Party and their son and to fulfil his educational and other needs.
6. That in view of the aforesaid, the Parties agreed to make a joint request before the Honble Supreme Court to accept the present settlement agreement and to maintain their marriage by their consent and grant to them the relief to stay together as a happily married couple along with their son, in exercise of its inherent jurisdiction under Article 142 of the Constitution of India at the time of disposal of the captioned Transfer Petition and to dispose of all the pending proceedings before sub- ordinate Courts.
7. That the Parties agree to undertake to the Honble Supreme Court to abide by the present settlement agreement.
8. That both the Parties further agree and undertake that they shall have no claim or right qua any immovable or movable properties of the other party or against the family members of the other party whether self-acquired, joint or ancestral under any circumstances now or in future, immediately in view of the present Settlement Agreement.

9. That pursuant to engrossing their signatures on the present Settlement Agreement,
both the Parties and have agreed to respect each other and their family members and the allegations made by the Parties against each other or against the family members and friends of either party shall stand withdrawn unequivocally upon the signing of the present Settlement Agreement and no abusive/disrespectful/offensive/insulting language shall be used by both the sides.

10. That the present Settlement Agreement is effective and enforceable from date of its execution and acceptance by the Honble Supreme Court and shall remain effective and binding on both the Parties.

11. That it is agreed between the Parties that they will strictly adhere of the terms and conditions of this Settlement and will do all acts necessary for the expeditious compliance of the same and shall cooperate with each other.

Further, the Parties have further confirmed and undertaken that they were given sufficient time and opportunity to consult their legal counsels of their choice and it is only after said consultations with the counsels of their choice, after full understanding of the effect of the terms and conditions of the present settlement Agreement, that the Parties have executed the present Settlement Agreement.
13.
The contents of this settlement - agreement have been explained to all the parties through their respective counsels and they have understood the same.
6. The parties are directed to abide by the terms of the Settlement.
7. All proceedings between the parties, civil or criminal, stand terminated.
8. The Original Settlement Agreement is ordered to be taken on record and shall be kept with the record of this case.
9. Nothing further is required to be done in the matter.
10. The Transfer Petition accordingly stands disposed of.
11. Pending application(s), if any, stand disposed of.
